shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls -la && ls app 2>/dev/null; ls src/app 2>/dev/null; git diff package.json
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; grep -o "export { connection[^;]*" node_modules/next/dist/server.js; grep -rn "cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" next.config.ts

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Unix milliseconds: <!-- -->[0-9]*'; sleep 1; curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Unix milliseconds: <!-- -->[0-9]*'; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
